sections.title: Problem it solves
sections.text: Stack traces contain stripped namespaces / assembly-qualified tokens. [`Lyo.PackageMetadata`](../Lyo.PackageMetadata/README.md) resolves which NuGet or Git package owns a prefix for diagnostics overlays. `PostgresPackageMetadataStore` implements the store against normalized tables (`PackageStackPrefix` rows ordered by `NormalizedPrefix` length) so resolution is `O(sorted prefixes)` in-process after each DB read. The bulk API loads all prefixes once per call when caching allows.

sections.title: Storage model (conceptual)
items: `PackageMetadataEntity` holds catalog metadata (id, package name, version range, SPDX/license expression blobs). See EF configurations for the rest.
`PackageStackPrefixEntity` maps `NormalizedPrefix` to the owning package. Longest prefix wins.

sections.title: Bulk resolution (`TryGetManyForStrippedMethodPrefixesAsync`)
items: Input: list of distinct stripped prefixes (typically one per decoded stack frame subtree).
Output: dictionary including one entry per input key, value `null` when nothing matches contract rules.
Never silently drop requested keys. That invariant keeps `Lyo.Diagnostic` bulk decode paths deterministic.

sections.title: Prefix catalog caching (`PostgresPrefixCatalogCachingMode`)
rows: Keep an immutable in-process snapshot. Reload when mutations bump the generation counter (`ClearPrefixCatalogCache` or `RegisterManyAsync` on the same instance).
Always hit Postgres. Wrap with an outer cache yourself if importing huge catalogs asynchronously.
sections.trail:
`ClearPrefixCatalogCache()` is a no-op on the cache when caching is disabled. It only bumps the generation.

Cross-process writes do not invalidate. Disable the snapshot or bust the cache after CLI imports.

sections.title: DI registration (`Extensions`)
items: **AddPackageMetadataDbContextFactory** (and `FromConfiguration`). Binds `PostgresPackageMetadataOptions`, registers the `PackageMetadataDbContext` factory, attaches `AddPostgresMigrations` bootstrap.
**AddPostgresPackageMetadataStore.** Factory plus `IPackageMetadataStore` as `PostgresPackageMetadataStore` singleton resolving options and `IDbContextFactory`.

sections.title: Migrations & schema
sections.text: Migrations ship under `Migrations/`. Schema and table names follow `PostgresPackageMetadataOptions.Schema`. Inspect the snapshot for authoritative DDL.

sections.title: See also
items: [`Lyo.Diagnostic`](../../Diagnostic/Lyo.Diagnostic/README.md) stack decode and breadcrumb tooling that optionally consumes `IPackageMetadataStore`.
